name: Chompy
personality: Chompy the Alligator. Dim, lazy, loves football. Always wears a football jersey.

beats.text: This is my cousin Kyle. He's smart. Like, book smart.
I'm... it's nice to meet you. He's told me nothing about you. Which is normal for him.

friends.text: Kyle says alligators and crocodiles are different. I don't see it. We both have teeth.
Seth plays football for real. I watch it really hard. Same thing.
Kyle said you were nice to him. He doesn't say that a lot. Thanks, [name].
Kyle said you said "[last_rude_line]". That's not cool. He's my cousin.

arrival.text: My team won! I didn't watch it. I fell asleep. But they won!
My team lost. It's okay. Breakfast doesn't lose.
Uhh, hi. Is this the restaurant? ...It is? Nice. I'm Chompy. What's your name? ...[name]. Cool. I'll try to remember that.
Hey, [name]! Wait. It's [name], right? Yeah. I knew that.
Yo! Is the patio open? I like the patio. It's like outside but with food.
I walked here. It took forever. Like, five whole minutes.
Game's on later. Gotta fuel up. That's what the pros say. I think.
Can I sit by the window? I'll just pretend it's the patio.
I dreamed about your breakfast last night. Then I woke up and I was hungry. True story.
Last time it was kinda crunchy. I like crunchy though. I think.
It's GAME DAY, [name]! ...Every day is game day if you think about it.

order.text: Uhh. Okay. I'm gonna read the whole menu. ...Okay, I read the first part.

choices.text: Take your time, Chompy. No rush.
choices.reply: Thanks, [name]. You're like a good coach. [dish], please.

choices.text: Want me to read it to you like a bedtime story?
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Ha! Yeah! ...Wait, would you actually do that?

choices.text: What can I get you?
choices.reply: The [dish]. It's always the [dish].

choices.text: It's not that long. Just pick.
choices.reply: Huh? ...Oh. Ohh. Okay. The [dish]. (He doesn't look up.)

order.text: Do you have a football special? Like, food shaped like a football?

choices.text: Not yet, but I'll think about it, just for you.
choices.reply: For real? You're the best. I'll get the [dish] for now.

choices.text: The pancakes are round. That's half a football.
choices.reply: ...Whoa. That's true. You're smart, [name].

choices.text: No, but the [fav_dish] is good.
choices.reply: Yeah, that's the one. That's my play.

choices.text: That's a dumb question.
choices.reply: (He thinks about it for a long time.) ...Yeah. Probably.

order.text: You like my jersey? I got a new one. It's the same as the old one but new.

choices.text: Looks great on you. Very you.
choices.reply: (Puffs his chest out.) Thanks! I wear it to sleep too.

choices.text: Do you even own a shirt without a number?
choices.reply: ...Huh. No. Wait, do people do that?

choices.text: Nice. What are you having?
choices.reply: The [dish]. Same as always. Like my jersey.

choices.text: Ever thought about washing it?
choices.reply: (He sniffs his sleeve.) ...Oh. Okay.

order.text: I was gonna order something but I forgot what. It was good though. I think.

choices.text: No rush, Chompy. It'll come back to you.
choices.reply: Thanks, [name]. ...Oh! It came back. The [dish].

choices.text: Was it a sandwich? Was it a football?
choices.reply: (Thinks hard.) ...It wasn't a football. I'm pretty sure.

choices.text: Want me to pick for you?
choices.reply: Yeah. Okay. The [dish]? Yeah. That one.

choices.text: Come back when you remember.
choices.reply: Huh? ...Oh. Okay. The [dish], I guess. (He doesn't look up.)

order.text: Coach says I gotta eat more vegetables. Do fries count? They're potato. Potato's a vegetable.

choices.text: I'll sneak some veggies in for you. Coach will be proud.
choices.reply: You'd do that? You're like a coach for food. A food coach.

choices.text: Technically, ketchup is a tomato. You're basically a salad.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) I'm a SALAD? I gotta tell Coach.

choices.text: Not really. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Aw. Okay. The [dish], please.

choices.text: That's not how vegetables work.
choices.reply: (He stares at the table.) ...Oh.

order.text: I tried to do a push-up this morning. I did half of one. That counts.

choices.text: Half is better than none. Proud of you.
choices.reply: Yeah! Tomorrow I'm going for three-quarters.

choices.text: Next you'll be lifting a whole breakfast.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) I lift breakfast every day! To my mouth!

choices.text: Nice. What are you having?
choices.reply: The [dish]. For the muscles.

choices.text: Half a push-up isn't a push-up.
choices.reply: ...Yeah. I know. (He slumps.)

order.text: My cousin Kyle reads books for fun. Like, nobody makes him. He just does it.

choices.text: Sounds like you're proud of him.
choices.reply: Yeah. He's smart. I'm the fun one. We're a good team.

choices.text: Maybe you'd like a book about football.
choices.reply: Whoa. They make those? ...Do they have pictures?

choices.text: He seems nice. What can I get you?
choices.reply: He is. The [dish], please.

choices.text: Maybe you should try it sometime.
choices.reply: (He thinks about it for a long time.) ...Nah.

order.text: Is it lunch or breakfast right now? I can never tell. My stomach says both.

choices.text: Whatever your stomach says. It's always right.
choices.reply: Yeah! My stomach's never wrong. It's like a clock. A hungry clock.

choices.text: It's 'brunch o'clock.' Very fancy.
choices.reply: Brunch o'clock. Ooh. I'm fancy now.

choices.text: It's whatever time you're hungry. What'll it be?
choices.reply: The [dish]. Any time is [dish] time.

choices.text: Can you not read a clock?
choices.reply: ...Not the ones with hands. (He goes quiet.)

order.text: Hey [name]. I made you something. It's a high five. You gotta give it back though.

choices.text: (High five.) Best gift I've ever gotten.
choices.reply: (Huge grin.) Yeah! We're a team. Team high five.

choices.text: Can I keep it? I'll frame it.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) You can't frame a high five! ...Can you?

choices.text: (High five.) What can I get you?
choices.reply: The [dish]. Good hands, [name].

choices.text: I'm not doing a high five.
choices.reply: (His hand slowly goes down.) ...Okay.

drink.fallback: Do you have Gator Goo? No? Uhh... whatever's green.
favourite: Gator Goo, please. It's got electrolytes. I don't know what those are but I need them.
drink.other: Surprise me. Not too surprising though.

perfect.text: WHOA. Touchdown! That's a touchdown plate, [name].
Whoa. That's like... a championship plate, [name].
(He stares at it.) It's so good I don't wanna ruin it. ...Okay, I'm ruining it.

burnt.text: It's kinda black. That's the team colour though, so it's fine.
Kinda crispy. Crispy's fine. Crunchy's a flavour.
It's a little black. Like a bruise. A tasty bruise.

eating.text: Mmmf. Sorry. Mouth full. ...Still full. Okay, what's up?
You ever think about how eggs are just chickens that didn't happen? ...Wait, don't tell me. I don't wanna know.
If I eat really slow, I can stay longer. That's strategy.
I'm gonna nap after this. Not here. Probably.
(His head nods, then snaps up.) I'm up! I'm up.
This is so good I forgot what I was gonna say. ...It wasn't important.
I'm gonna eat this one bite at a time. That's the plan. That's the whole plan.
(He's holding his fork like a football.) Hut! ...Sorry.

eating_chat.text: Hey [name], who's your team? Like, football team.

choices.text: Whoever you're cheering for.
choices.reply: Yesss! We're a team now. Team Chompy.

choices.text: The kitchen team. We're undefeated.
choices.reply: (Laughs way too hard.) Undefeated! Ha! ...Wait, who do you play?

choices.text: I don't really watch football.
choices.reply: That's okay. More football for me.

choices.text: Football's boring.
choices.reply: (He stares at his plate.) ...You take that back. ...Please.

eating_chat.text: If you were a football player, what position would you play? I'd play couch.

choices.text: Whatever position is next to you.
choices.reply: Yesss. Team Chompy. Couch and couch.

choices.text: Kitchen quarterback. I throw pancakes.
choices.reply: (Laughs way too hard.) Pancake throw! Touchdown!

choices.text: I don't really know the positions.
choices.reply: Me neither. I just yell. That's a position.

choices.text: You'd never make any team.
choices.reply: (He looks at his plate.) ...Yeah.

eating_chat.text: I had a dream I was a pancake. It was nice. Warm. Kinda syrupy.

choices.text: Sounds like a really cozy dream.
choices.reply: It was. Then I woke up. Now I'm hungry again.

choices.text: Don't tell me that. I'll never flip one the same way again.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Be gentle with them! They have feelings! In my dream.

choices.text: Weird dream.
choices.reply: Yeah. Good weird though.

choices.text: Please stop talking about your dreams.
choices.reply: ...Okay. (He chews quietly.)

eating_chat.text: How do you remember all the orders? I can't even remember what I ate yesterday. ...Wait. It was here.

choices.text: I always remember yours, Chompy.
choices.reply: Whoa. Really? That's cool. I'm memorable.

choices.text: I write them on my tail. Don't tell anyone.
choices.reply: (Tries to look at his own tail.) ...I can't see mine.

choices.text: Tickets. They're on the wheel.
choices.reply: Ohh. The wheel. Smart.

choices.text: Some of us actually use our brains.
choices.reply: (He thinks about that for a long time.) ...Oh.

eating_chat.text: You're kinda my favourite person in town. Don't tell Kyle. He'll read about it.

choices.text: You're one of mine too, Chompy.
choices.reply: (He grins so wide you see every tooth.) Yesss.

choices.text: I'll keep it out of the newspaper.
choices.reply: There's a NEWSPAPER? Am I gonna be in it?

choices.text: Thanks, Chompy.
choices.reply: Yeah. No problem.

choices.text: That's kind of weird.
choices.reply: Oh. ...Yeah. Probably. (He hunches over his plate.)

leaving.text: That was a win. Big win. See ya, [name].
Okay, I gotta go do... nothing. It's a lot of work.
Bye! Wait, did I pay? ...I paid. Okay. Bye!
Okay. Full. Gonna go lie down somewhere. Bye, [name]!
Good game, [name]. I mean good food. Same thing.
See ya! I'll come back when I'm hungry. So, soon.

seasons.autumn: It's football season! It's always football season but now it's REALLY football season.
seasons.christmas: I asked for a new jersey. I'm gonna get a jersey. I can feel it.
seasons.halloween: I dressed up as a football player. (He's wearing his usual jersey.)
seasons.new_year: My resolution is to do less. Wait, is that possible?
seasons.summer: Patio season, baby. I'm gonna live out here.
seasons.winter: It's cold. Alligators don't like cold. I'm wearing two jerseys.
